notes: Return-from-graveyard modeled via move(validType:'any') — no instant/sorcery filter exists on move, AND no Card method anywhere in this model (interfaces.ts) can distinguish an instant/sorcery card once it's in a zone (isCreature/isLand/isEnchantment/isArtifact exist; no isInstant/isSorcery, no typeLine accessor), so a custom filter isn't possible either — a genuinely absent capability, not just a declarative-shape gap. No PlayerState field seeds a non-creature graveyard card, so the real success case can't be scenario-tested at all; only the empty-graveyard no-op is demonstrated.
knownGaps: return-target-instant-or-sorceryfrom-graveyard has no real type filter available anywhere in the runtime model (only the synergy.json fact's own types.hasAny declares it, unenforced by definition.ts's move effect)
'or exiled card with flashback you own' alternate source zone is entirely undeclared (move only supports one from-zone)
'Add {R}' is unmodeled — no mana-pool concept anywhere in this model
no PlayerState field can seed a graveyard with a non-creature card, so the actual return-to-hand success case has zero scenario coverage
